FN-9JDVGBP-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 341
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Jerry Starnes
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/02/2026
House Bill 341 as introduced would decrease income tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund
by an estimated $1.9 million in Fiscal Year 2027 (for the partial, 3/4 fiscal year) and $2.6
million annually thereafter (full fiscal year) by exempting the first $5,000 of inactive duty
training pay received by a Alabama National Guard member beginning January 1, 2027.
Page 1

and $2.6 million annually thereafter (full fiscal year) by exempting the first $5,000 of inactive
duty training pay received by a Alabama National Guard member beginning January 1, 2027.

House Bill 341
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Representative Jerry Starnes
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/04/2026
House Bill 341 as reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation Education would
decrease income tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by the estimated amounts below by
exempting the first $5,000 of inactive duty training pay received by an Alabama National Guard
member beginning January 1, 2027.
Fiscal Year Estimated Amount
2027 $1.9 million
2028 $2.6 million
2029 $2.6 million
2030 $650,000
